what.title: What is Agental
what.body: Agental is an AI-powered talent agency. Each performer gets an AI agent that finds roles that fit and prepares submissions the performer approves. Casting directors receive ranked shortlists with the reasoning shown, and representation goes through a licensed partner agency.

facts.title: You approve every submission
facts.body: Your agent prepares it. You decide whether it goes out.
